subject.title: fix(github-copilot): prevent stale encrypted reasoning failures

question: Should this combined PR become the canonical stale-Copilot-replay fix, or should its generic recovery move to the packages/ai Responses lifecycle before landing?
rationale: The provider-specific prevention is well supported, but multiple open branches implement overlapping recovery at different runtime boundaries; repository policy requires a deliberate single-owner decision rather than parallel recovery implementations.

options.title: Land combined fix
options.body: Confirm the streamSimple sibling is either covered or separately necessary, finish exact-head checks, and use this PR as the canonical provider-prevention plus managed-transport repair.

options.title: Move shared recovery
options.body: Keep provider-owned sanitation here but consolidate the generic bounded retry in packages/ai so Responses runtimes share one recovery implementation.

options.title: Prefer narrower branches
options.body: Pause this PR and select the older provider-only and drain-only proposals, accepting the additional coordination and drift risk.
